# The trim of the IfcOpenShell source tree (ADR 0171 decision 21). scripts/vendor-ifcopenshell.py
# reads this file: each rule is `keep PATH` or `drop PATTERN`, applied in order to every file of
# the upstream tag archive, and the last rule that matches a file decides. A file that no rule
# matches is not vendored. Patterns: `**` crosses directories, `*` does not.
# What remains is byte for byte upstream; any change to it belongs in PATCHES.md instead.

# Licence texts and the version file the top-level build reads.
keep VERSION
keep COPYING
keep COPYING.LESSER
keep README.md

# The build definition (a top-level project: it reads ../src/*).
keep cmake/

# The libraries: IfcParse, the plugin loader, IfcGeom and the two small serializer-runtime files
# IfcGeom compiles. src/ifcfuzz is upstream's libFuzzer parser harness (J3).
keep src/ifcparse/
keep src/ifcgeom/
keep src/plugin/
keep src/serializers/
keep src/ifcfuzz/

# Upstream's own tests fetch Catch2 over the network and are not built.
drop src/ifcparse/tests/**
drop src/ifcgeom/tests/**

# Three schemas (IFC2X3, IFC4, IFC4X3_ADD2) and the STEP header schema; the other eight
# generated schemas are 50 MB and are not accepted (decision 2).
drop src/ifcparse/schemas/**
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Header_section_schema.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Header_section_schema.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Header_section_schema-schema.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc2x3.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc2x3.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc2x3-definitions.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc2x3-schema.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4-definitions.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4-schema.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4x3_add2.cpp
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4x3_add2.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4x3_add2-definitions.h
keep src/ifcparse/schemas/Ifc4x3_add2-schema.cpp

# The OpenCASCADE and pass-through kernels are built. CGAL (GPL-3.0-or-later parts) is never
# linked and Manifold is off by default.
drop src/ifcgeom/kernels/cgal/**
drop src/ifcgeom/kernels/manifold/**
